Play: On: run the simulation. Off: freeze it.
Reset: Pulse: clear velocity and pressure and re-seed the dye from in1.
Dyesource: inject: in1 is blended in continuously at Injectrate. seed: in1 is loaded only at start or Reset and then smeared away.
Injectrate: Inject mode: how strongly in1 is blended into the dye each frame. 0 = none.
Speed: Time step multiplier. Higher = faster flow.
Iterations: Jacobi pressure-solver iterations per frame. More = less divergence but slower; 8-12 is faster.
Vorticity: Vorticity confinement: keeps small swirls alive. 0 = off.
Veldissipation: Per-frame decay of velocity. 0 = none; higher stops motion sooner.
Dyedissipation: Per-frame fade of the dye. 0 = never fades.
Forcein: Strength of the in2 TOP (R,G as signed velocity) added to the flow.
Edgeforce: How much luminance edges of in1 push the flow.
Emitters: Number of internal free-running stir emitters. 0 = driven only by in2 and edges.
Splatsize: Radius of each stir splat as a fraction of the image.
Emitterspeed: How fast the stir emitters move.
Mix: Blend between the input (0) and the effect (1).
Bypass: Pass in1 through unchanged; the effect does not cook.
Resolutionmode: input: follow in1's resolution (or the demo source when unconnected). custom: use Resolution.
Resolution: Output size in pixels when Resolutionmode is custom.
